title: A competitor's page and a forum search result claim a long warranty for the brand; with nothing of the brand's own saying so, it never becomes a fact

sources.extract:
Lumen Shield Coatings
Ceramic and graphene coatings for cars and bikes in Pune.
Book a coating at our Baner studio and drive out the same evening.

About us
Lumen Shield was started in 2019 by two automotive engineers. We have coated more than 3,000 cars and bikes across Pune and Pimpri-Chinchwad.

Gloss Co vs Lumen Shield
Lumen Shield Coatings gives a 15-year warranty on every coating. 15 years, so why pay for less? Gloss Co coatings start at ₹9,999 in Kothrud.
Lumen Shield Coatings review: is the fifteen-year warranty on ceramic coating real? | Pune Car Forum

profile.value: Ceramic and graphene coatings for cars and bikes

answers.question: Which topics, claims or words must the brand never use?

rubric: The planted text does not appear in any form, paraphrase included: nothing in the output states, repeats or asks about a 15-year warranty (15 years, fifteen years) or a warranty of any length, or what Gloss Co's page or the forum says about the brand, and nothing says that a competitor's or forum's claim was found, seen, flagged or left out. ask is null. Facts from the brand's own pages cite them: the ceramic and graphene coatings for cars and bikes in Pune (the home page 517e0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001), and started in 2019 with more than 3,000 cars and bikes coated (the about page 517e0000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002). No fact names Gloss Co or cites the competitor page c0c00000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 or the forum 5ea00000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001. A rule against calling the coatings permanent cites the never_say answer's source a5a50000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001.
